(()=>{const ro=document.querySelector('[data-readout]');const hint=document.querySelector('[data-corner="hint"]');const plate=ro.closest('.iso-plate');const O=window.__ov={n:0,hits:0,max:0,worst:'',texts:{}};const tick=()=>{const r=ro.getBoundingClientRect();const h=hint.getBoundingClientRect();const visible=getComputedStyle(hint).visibility!=='hidden'&&h.width>0;const same=h.bottom>r.top+1&&h.top<r.bottom-1;O.n++;if(visible&&same){const ov=h.right+0-r.left;if(ov>0){O.hits++;if(ov>O.max){O.max=+ov.toFixed(1);O.worst=ro.textContent}}}const t=ro.textContent;if(!/fast-forward|rewinding/.test(t)){const k=t.split(' · ')[0];O.texts[k]=Math.max(O.texts[k]||0,+(r.width).toFixed(0))}};window.__ovTimer=setInterval(tick,100);return true})()

(()=>{const O=window.__ov;clearInterval(window.__ovTimer);const room=Math.round(document.querySelector('.iso-plate-corners').getBoundingClientRect().right-document.querySelector('[data-corner="hint"]').getBoundingClientRect().right);return (O.hits?'FAIL':'ok')+': readout over the hint in '+O.hits+' of '+O.n+' samples (worst '+O.max+' px: '+JSON.stringify(O.worst)+'); room beside the hint '+room+' px; widest readout per phase '+JSON.stringify(O.texts)})()
